name: Proving Grounds - structure-only rushers, composed for free
notes: Three designs (Hog Rider, Wall-Breaker, Bomber) that needed zero new kernel code: each is targetLayers (built for the ground-air asymmetry) restricted to obstacles, composed with a normal attack, a contact detonation, or the air layer respectively - already-proven capabilities meeting with no glue code between them. The hogrider and saboteur ignore the two citizen troopers entirely and beeline the barracks; the bomber, being on the air layer, never even has to route around them. Watch whether the troopers can intercept anyway just by standing in the way - targeting and collision are separate questions (engine.md 3.4.1), so a rusher that will not fight a trooper can still be physically blocked by one.
